evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct music discovery method based on fingerprinting; no other story expresses the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Uses the user's own profile as the discovery source, distinguishing it from collaborative and content-based stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative user-similarity basis is distinct from profile-based and content-based discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Specific video-based music/ringback search by content similarity is contextually distinct from general fingerprinting or metadata stories.

evaluations.evidence: enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/image-tag exploration path is distinct from other music discovery methods.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Unique focus on tag ingestion and availability for downstream processing.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Distinct user-facing video segment browsing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: General similar video information is distinct from the perceptually scoped version in ZO-009.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity narrows the similarity type and gives a meaningful business-rule difference from ZO-008.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation delivery from similar profiles is distinct from proactive music search/discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News-event and location-based recommendation context is unique.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos
evaluations.rationale: Person-specific identification distinguishes it from product, logo, and brand identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a distinct object category from persons, logos, and brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a distinct object type from persons, products, and brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from person, product, and broadcaster-logo identification.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Image-based video recommendation is a unique interaction and goal.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: Geographic map exploration of content is unique.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct search mechanism in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Unique admin moderation/editing requirement for video segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: News segment annotation and topic extraction is distinct from segmentation validation.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering/ranking is a specific admin capability not expressed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio edit detection pre-upload is unique.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity-specific content prefiltering is a distinct business rule.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset search is distinct from high-level metadata/tag prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright infringement validation is a unique compliance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset search.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Image appeal/complexity assessment is distinct from scientist-prompt detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist prompting based on annotations/Talk comments is a separate goal from appeal assessment.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer type identification is a unique admin analysis requirement.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo image preclassification is domain-specific and distinct from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Snapshot Serengeti no-animal detection is distinct from Plankton Portal no-plankton detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Timestamp-malfunction image series detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from attribute and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification differs from species and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal number detection is distinct from species and attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton localization is distinct from other plankton and Snapshot Serengeti tasks.

evaluations.evidence: Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Plankton-specific no-class detection is distinct from Snapshot Serengeti no-animal detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection differs from localization and species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is domain-distinct from animal species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis is distinct from egg-laying detection and other admin tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying timestamp detection is a specific temporal event distinct from motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Satellite image feature detection is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification weighting by experience is distinct from volunteer type identification.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Image artefact removal is distinct from nudity/content prefiltering and object detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a specific image-analysis goal.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is distinct from whale call grouping and whale counting.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is a domain-specific task, meaningfully different from general subject grouping in ZO-058.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Whale counting is distinct from whale-call grouping and audio noise removal.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of volunteer interruption is distinct from interruption medium/channel in ZO-050.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Modality choice for interruption is distinct from the timing question in ZO-049.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of education is distinct from education medium/channel in ZO-052.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality choice is distinct from the timing question in ZO-051.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Specific educational content selection is distinct from whether or when to educate.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting volunteer comments is distinct from Zoonibot commenting and explanation actions.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Commenting timing is distinct from explanation timing in ZO-056.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is distinct from general commenting timing in ZO-055.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message content selection is distinct from when Zoonibot should comment or explain.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject grouping is distinct from domain-specific whale-call grouping in ZO-047.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation based on volunteer experience is distinct from content recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique admin requirement.
